About this item

  • The C1 Simply Clean brush head with soft, flexible bristles removes more plaque than a manual toothbrush while protecting your gums
  • Electric toothbrush for adults providing gentle yet effective cleaning: the Advanced Sonic Technology pulses fluid between teeth and along the gumline for even more effective oral care
  • Optimize your routine: EasyStart for a gradual, gentle increase in brushing power, SmarTimer informing when you've reached 2 minutes, and QuadPacer to brush each section of a mouth for 30 seconds
  • Rechargeable toothbrush providing up to 14 days of regular brushing on a full charge
  • Philips Sonicare toothbrush from the #1 dental professional recommended sonic toothbrush brand worldwide²: benefit from Philips expertise to keep your teeth and gums in the best condition
  • The set includes: 1x Philips Sonicare 1100 Series electric toothbrush, 1x C1 Simply Clean brush head, 1x USB charger (power adaptor not included)

Important information

Safety Information

Do not swallow. Not intended for use by children who may put it in their mouths. Do not use for purposes other than oral hygiene.

Directions

1. Remove the toothbrush from its packaging. 2. Charge the toothbrush for at least 24 hours before use. 3. Attach the SimplyClean (C1) brush head to the toothbrush handle. 4. Wet the brush head and apply toothpaste. 5. Press the power button to turn on the toothbrush. 6. Brush for 2 minutes, using the SmarTimer and QuadPacer to ensure even brushing. 7. Rinse the brush head and toothbrush handle after use. 8. Charge the toothbrush after each use to ensure a long battery life. 9. Subscribe to brush head replacements to ensure optimal performance.

Product Description

Achieve better plaque removal than with a manual toothbrush thanks to the Philips Sonicare 1100 Series sonic toothbrush paired with the C1 Simply Clean electric toothbrush head. Enjoy a powerful yet gentle clean, even in those hard-to-reach areas. The Advanced Sonic Technology provides gentle yet effective cleaning, pulsing fluid between teeth and along the gumline. To help you get used to the Sonicare experience, the EasyStart feature adjusts the power level of the toothbrush over the first 14 uses. Improve your brushing technique with QuadPacer, which reminds you to brush each section of your mouth for 30 seconds, and reach your recommended brushing time of 2 minutes with SmarTimer. Experience up to 14 days of regular brushing after a single charge, bringing a new level of convenience to your brushing routine (based on two periods of two-minute brushings per day on standard mode). Dental professionals recommend changing brush heads every 3 months.

    Simple, effective, and reliable sonic cleaning without the extra frills!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 3, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    As an Amazon Vine Voice, I tested the PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush over a two-week period, using it for twice-daily brushing routines to evaluate its cleaning power, battery life, and overall usability. If you want to step up from a manual toothbrush without paying for expensive, feature-heavy models you'll never use, this stripped-down sonic brush is a compelling option. 

    Here is my honest breakdown of how it performs:

    ⭐ Cleaning Performance & Power

    Sonic Technology: Delivering solid vibration action, it drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline. It leaves your mouth feeling remarkably fresh—way cleaner than any standard manual brush. 

    Single-Mode Simplicity: It features just one cleaning speed and one button. While it lacks multiple intensity settings or fancy pulse cycles, it focuses entirely on doing the core job exceptionally well. 

    Easy-Start Feature: If you are new to electric toothbrushes, it includes a built-in feature that gently ramps up the power gradually over your first 14 brushing sessions to prevent gum sensitivity. 

    🛠️ Design & Usability

    Slim & Lightweight: The handle has a sleek, ergonomic profile that feels comfortable and lightweight in the hand without taking up unnecessary counter space. 

    Smart Timers: The integrated SmarTimer automatically shuts the brush off after the dentist-recommended 2 minutes, while the QuadPacer pulses every 30 seconds to signal when you should switch quadrants of your mouth. 

    🔋 Battery Life & Charging

    Dependable Endurance: The internal rechargeable battery easily lasts up to 2 weeks (around 14 days) on a single charge under normal use. 

    Convenient Indicator: A subtle battery level LED indicator alerts you when it's time to drop it back on its USB charging base. 

    🛑 Minor Cons to Consider

    No Pressure Sensor: Because this is a budget-friendly model, it lacks a pressure sensor warning light. If you have a heavy hand, you'll need to mind how hard you press manually. 

    Basic Accessories: The kit keeps things minimal with just the handle, one brush head, and a USB charging stand (wall adapter block not always included). 

    The Verdict

    The PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 proves you don’t need to spend a fortune to get a dentist-clean mouth. It cuts out the complicated modes in favor of reliable timers, great battery life, and powerful sonic action. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a straightforward, high-value electric toothbrush!

About this Item

  • The C1 Simply Clean brush head with soft, flexible bristles removes more plaque than a manual toothbrush while protecting your gums
  • Electric toothbrush for adults providing gentle yet effective cleaning: the Advanced Sonic Technology pulses fluid between teeth and along the gumline for even more effective oral care
  • Optimize your routine: EasyStart for a gradual, gentle increase in brushing power, SmarTimer informing when you've reached 2 minutes, and QuadPacer to brush each section of a mouth for 30 seconds
  • Rechargeable toothbrush providing up to 14 days of regular brushing on a full charge
  • Philips Sonicare toothbrush from the #1 dental professional recommended sonic toothbrush brand worldwide²: benefit from Philips expertise to keep your teeth and gums in the best condition
  • The set includes: 1x Philips Sonicare 1100 Series electric toothbrush, 1x C1 Simply Clean brush head, 1x USB charger (power adaptor not included)

Product Description

Achieve better plaque removal than with a manual toothbrush thanks to the Philips Sonicare 1100 Series sonic toothbrush paired with the C1 Simply Clean electric toothbrush head. Enjoy a powerful yet gentle clean, even in those hard-to-reach areas. The Advanced Sonic Technology provides gentle yet effective cleaning, pulsing fluid between teeth and along the gumline. To help you get used to the Sonicare experience, the EasyStart feature adjusts the power level of the toothbrush over the first 14 uses. Improve your brushing technique with QuadPacer, which reminds you to brush each section of your mouth for 30 seconds, and reach your recommended brushing time of 2 minutes with SmarTimer. Experience up to 14 days of regular brushing after a single charge, bringing a new level of convenience to your brushing routine (based on two periods of two-minute brushings per day on standard mode). Dental professionals recommend changing brush heads every 3 months.

Important Information

Safety Information

Do not swallow. Not intended for use by children who may put it in their mouths. Do not use for purposes other than oral hygiene.

Directions

1. Remove the toothbrush from its packaging. 2. Charge the toothbrush for at least 24 hours before use. 3. Attach the SimplyClean (C1) brush head to the toothbrush handle. 4. Wet the brush head and apply toothpaste. 5. Press the power button to turn on the toothbrush. 6. Brush for 2 minutes, using the SmarTimer and QuadPacer to ensure even brushing. 7. Rinse the brush head and toothbrush handle after use. 8. Charge the toothbrush after each use to ensure a long battery life. 9. Subscribe to brush head replacements to ensure optimal performance.
